installCommand: if [ -f site/index.html ]; then echo '==> Prebuilt site/ was uploaded with this deployment - skipping the Python install.'; else python3 -m pip install --disable-pip-version-check -r requirements.txt || python3 -m pip install --disable-pip-version-check --user -r requirements.txt || python3 -m pip install --disable-pip-version-check --user --break-system-packages -r requirements.txt; fi
buildCommand: if [ -f site/index.html ]; then echo '==> Publishing the uploaded site/ as-is. It is only as fresh as the machine that ran `mkdocs build`.'; else echo '==> No prebuilt site/ - building the docs with MkDocs.'; python3 -m mkdocs build; fi && find site -name '*.map' -delete
ignoreCommand: [ -n "$VERCEL_GIT_PREVIOUS_SHA" ] && git cat-file -e "$VERCEL_GIT_PREVIOUS_SHA" 2>/dev/null && git diff --quiet "$VERCEL_GIT_PREVIOUS_SHA" HEAD -- docs mkdocs.yml requirements.txt vercel.json
